item.title: 1989 Mercedes-Benz 560SL at No Reserve
item.description: This 1989 Mercedes-Benz 560SL was purchased by the current owner on BaT in September 2024, and subsequent work included replacing the black soft top, timing chain and tensioner, spark plugs, valve cover gasket, tires, control arms, and shocks. Finished in Signal Red over Palomino leather upholstery, the car is powered by a 5.5-liter V8 paired with a four-speed automatic transmission. Equipment includes a limited-slip differential, a removable hardtop, silver-finished 15" Gullideckel alloy wheels

item.title: 2003 Chevrolet TrailBlazer LTZ at No Reserve
item.description: This 2003 Chevrolet TrailBlazer LTZ has 98k miles and a registration history in Oregon. Power is provided by a 4.2-liter inline-six paired with a four-speed automatic transmission and a dual-range transfer case, and the truck is finished in Dark Gray Metallic over gray leather. Equipment includes 17" alloy wheels, a roof rack, running boards, a receiver hitch, heated power-adjustable front seats, dual-zone automatic climate control, and a CD stereo. item.description: This 1999 BMW 323i has been registered in Florida since new, and its odometer now indicates 54k miles. item.description: A few of the comments that stood out to us yesterday: "In 1979 a friend of mine's brother bought a new first year RX-7. I had the opportunity to drive it. item.title: Neon Plymouth Road Runner Signs at No Reserve
item.description: These reproduction neon Road Runner signs both feature a rendering of the cartoon logo, and one of the birds is holding a racing helmet. Both pieces feature multicolor neon illumination, 120-volt power, and US-style wall plugs. Acquired by the seller in 2025, this pair of Road Runner signs is now offered at no reserve in Dundee, Illinois.

item.title: 1947 International Harvester KB-3 Pickup
item.description: This 1947 International Harvester KB-3 pickup was refurbished before the current owner's 2014 purchase and is powered by a 214ci L-head inline-six linked with a three-speed manual transmission. The truck is finished in red and black over black and red vinyl, and equipment includes running boards, wood bed-side stakes, a wood-plank cargo bed, a side-mounted spare tire, and an under-dash heater. item.title: 1,216cc-Powered 1991 Suzuki GSX-R1100
item.description: This 1991 Suzuki GSX-R1100 was acquired by the seller in 2006, reportedly from its original owner, and it was modified in 2018 by Orient Express Racing of Brentwood, New York. Its 1,052cc inline-four was rebuilt to displace 1,216cc and the gears in its five-speed transmission were undercut. The bike was fitted with a Yoshimura exhaust system, Mikuni flat-slide carburetors, an inverted fork, a 240-width rear tire, a shift light, an ignition tether, and color-coordinating rider and passenger seats

item.title: Single-Turbo 1993 Mazda RX-7 5-Speed
item.description: This 1993 Mazda RX-7 was acquired by the seller in 2007, and the 1.3-liter Wankel rotary was modified with a Garrett single-turbo setup circa 2021. The engine is believed to have produced over 1,000 horsepower on a dynamometer in 2021 following a noted semi-peripheral port, and it utilizes a Pro-Jay Typhoon intake manifold, a Microtech ECU with flex-fuel capability, a water-to-air intercooler, dual blow-off valves, and a Turbosmart PowerGate60 external wastegate.
